title: Scraper bug: Lenovo scraper hits HTTP 500 from datacentersupport API
description:

Expected: 
Actual: 

The Lenovo scraper (CL-87) crashes on its first XClarity API call with a 500
from datacentersupport.lenovo.com. The 500 response body redirects to a
"pagenotfound" handler, suggesting the API path or product ID is wrong.

## Reproduction

    $ uv run psp-etl scrape lenovo
    httpx.HTTPStatusError: Server error '500 Internal Server Error' for url
    'https://datacentersupport.lenovo.com/us/en/pagenotfound?item=
    http%3A%2F%2Fdatacentersupport.lenovo.com%2Fapi%2Fv4%2Fdownloads%2Fdrivers%
    3FproductId%3D7d9c'

## Root cause

The constructed URL is `…/api/v4/downloads/drivers?productId=7d9c`. The 500
response wraps the redirect to a 404 handler. Either:
1. The machine type 7d9c is not valid for this API endpoint
2. The API path /api/v4/downloads/drivers has changed (Lenovo's APIs are not
   stable)
3. ThinkSystem product IDs need to be on `pcsupport.lenovo.com` rather than
   `datacentersupport.lenovo.com` (or vice versa)

The CL-87 commit message explicitly notes "Lenovo identifies each board by its
machine type rather than a model name … no public model->MTM lookup endpoint
we can crawl" — so the curated MTM table needs auditing.

## Fix

1. Audit the per-machine-type table in src/psp_etl/scrape/lenovo.py against the
   actual current Lenovo support center (each MTM has a stable URL on either
   datacentersupport or pcsupport — visit each manually and confirm the correct
   subdomain + that the API endpoint still resolves).
2. Wrap each per-machine-type call in try/except so one bad MTM doesn't crash
   the whole scrape.
3. Consider the alternative XClarity Suggest API path:
   https://support.lenovo.com/services/ContentService/SearchDrivers
   (used by renxulei/lenovo-redfish-library; less subdomain-sensitive).

## Acceptance criteria

- `uv run psp-etl scrape lenovo --dry-run` lists ThinkStation P620 BIOS URLs
  without error
- a 500 from any single MTM logs warn-and-continue instead of crashing

Refs: CL-87.
